c-member-online-indicator.2.evidence: Carlos and Omar (last seen more than 300s ago) have no is-online class on reply cards, and carlos' profile header has none.

c-member-online-indicator.3.evidence: Dot ::after is absolute top -2px, 10px wide, at left 24px on a 36px avatar and left 18px on a 30px avatar: top-right corner at both sizes. Large size (profile header) not measured.

c-member-online-indicator.4.evidence: he_IL RTL (cookie-scoped locale): the dot stays attached to the avatar corner (left:55px of a 64px avatar, same corner as LTR, 2px ring), no drift; note it is not mirrored to the left corner.

c-member-online-indicator.5.evidence: Grace (initials avatar, GR) made active: her profile shows an online dot on the initials avatar.

c-member-online-indicator.7.evidence: No online-status setting and no member privacy toggle exists in this build (nothing in includes/ defines one), so the "switch off" arm cannot be run; the check line describes a control that is not shipped.

c-member-online-indicator.8.evidence: Guest sees 6 online dots on a topic page, consistent with member view; guest REST last_seen_at is the current server time (moves 21:24:00 -> 21:24:04), never a stored time.

c-member-online-indicator.9.evidence: omar (space-banned) and finn (silenced) made active show a normal dot on their profiles.

c-member-online-indicator.12.evidence: Logged-out GET /users/9 returns the current server time (21:24:00 then 21:24:04, tracking now) for an online member and null for an offline one (user 15); the stored value is never exposed to guests.
